thread:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] routing-flap detected for smart-routing; p95 > 700ms for 4/6 windows and 5 reroutes in last 8m. Auto-fallback engaged to region=ap-southeast-1 variant=redwood-quant-rt. Paging oncall. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/routing/overview?from=-20m :rotating_light:
Oncall-Diego: ACK — I'm on. Priya Sam, Nikhil please join. Any customer reports?
Priya: joining. Noticed repeated route decisions flipping between us-west-2 and ap-southeast-1. The ap region uses the quantized runtime variant with lower token throughput; its decoding latency + backend cold-start retries are spiking tail.
Sam: also seeing a spike in client-side retries and a bump in 504s from nginx LB when ap nodes spike. Traces show increased tokenization/compile time on that variant.
Nikhil: policy logs show we evaluate p95 across 60s windows and immediately promote the lower-latency region — but we're using raw p95 without factoring in variant health or failure rate. When ap's variant has intermittent errors, effective latency jumps -> policy flips back -> causes oscillation.
Oncall-Diego: mitigation options: 1) disable auto-fallback globally 2) add soft-throttle to ap-southeast for 10m 3) pin enterprise tenants to stable variant 4) increase policy min_windows and add health gating. Thoughts?
Priya: prefer minimal blast radius: 1) disable auto-fallback for all prod routes now 2) add reroute-alert (reroutes >3 in 10m) 3) pin top-affected customers. I'll run disable if no objections.
SRE-Leah: +1. Also recommend temporary traffic-split to favor us-west-2 95/5 instead of full cutover to avoid cold starts.
Oncall-Diego: go ahead Priya. Use `redwood routing update --policy auto-fallback --enabled false --env prod`
Priya: running: `redwood routing update --policy auto-fallback --enabled false --env prod`
DeployBot: Accepted: auto-fallback disabled by Priya for env=prod. Config refresh to control-plane queued.
Sam: after disable, reroutes dropped immediately. p95 fell from ~820ms -> ~210ms in ~40s. However, we're still seeing elevated 5xx from the quantized variant for requests that were routed mid-change.
Nikhil: I'll start pinning enterprise customers impacted by high error rates: `redwood route pin --model redwood-gold-v2 --selector="tier:enterprise"`
CS-Bot: Notifying customers: estimated affected tenants=12; highest impacted=FinEdge (8% error rate). CS notified; template incident email queued. No data exposures.
Oncall-Diego: setting severity to Sev2. Handoff: Priya you take lead on policy changes, Nikhil do customer pins. Sam/SRE-Leah monitor infra health. Next oncall in 25m: SRE-Leah, please be prepared to own 2h watch.
SRE-Leah: acknowledged — will monitor reroute count and health check failures. Also recommend we create reroute burn alert: `alert: routing.reroute_count > 3 for 10m` and `alert: variant.health_success_ratio < 0.85 for 5m`
Priya: quick patch proposal for policy config to prevent flip-flop:
```yaml
policy: auto-fallback
window_seconds: 60
min_consecutive_windows: 3
cooldown_seconds: 600
min_variant_success_ratio: 0.9
```
I'll open a PR and run through canary.
Sam: infra action item: add canary that intentionally exercises quantized variant cold-start path and check latency/regression. Leah, can you own that?
SRE-Leah: yes, adding a canary job. ETA 2 days for full test harness, short-term synthetic in 3h.
Oncall-Diego: any need for immediate regional throttle? We can set a soft quota to ap-southeast-1 to limit requests while fixes land.
Nikhil: setting soft throttle: `redwood traffic set --region ap-southeast-1 --max_rps 1200 --scope prod` — applying now.
DeployBot: Traffic policy updated: ap-southeast-1 max_rps=1200 by Nikhil.
Sam: after throttle and disable, 502/504s trending down. p95 stable at ~230ms. Reroutes stopped.
CS-Bot: CS update: sent immediate notifications to top 12 tenants and scheduled follow-up calls with FinEdge and BetaBank. Suggested impacted window: approx 12:10-12:30 UTC.
Oncall-Diego: marking mitigated. Please capture timeline and root cause in postmortem. Assigning follow-ups: Priya (PR for policy cooldown + health gating), Nikhil (pin audit + customer list), SRE-Leah (canary + alerting), Sam (dashboard + traces).
Priya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/policies/1234 — includes tests and canary plan. Will coordinate rollout with SRE.
Nikhil: pinned 9 enterprise tenants, leaving 3 on default. Audit script created to verify pins: `scripts/verify_pins.sh`
SRE-Leah: created alert runbook for reroute burn and variant health, added dashboards.
Oncall-Diego: handoff to SRE-Leah in 20m. If any reappearance (reroute_count > 2 in 30m), escalate to engineering leads.
IncidentBot: Incident status: mitigated. Severity: 2. Please file postmortem in #postmortems and link this thread.
Oncall-Diego: closing thread — thanks everyone for quick coordination. Add anything else to the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
